L9: # Title:Transcendence and linear relations of $1$-periods
L10: 
L11: Authors:【6†Annette Huber】, 【7†Gisbert Wüstholz】
L12: 
L13: View a PDF of the paper titled Transcendence and linear relations of $1$-periods, by Annette Huber and Gisbert W\"ustholz
L14: 
L15: 【8†View PDF】 【9†HTML (experimental)】
L16: > Abstract:We study four fundamental questions about $1$-periods and give complete answers. 1) We give a necessary and sufficient for a period integral to be transcendental. 2) We give a qualitative description of all $\overline{\mathbf{Q}}$-linear relations between $1$-periods, establishing Kontsevich's period conjecture in this case. 3) Periods may vanish and we determine all cases when this happens.
L17: 4) For a fixed $1$-motive, we derive a general formula for the dimension of its space of periods in the spirit of Baker's theorem.
